preexisting_findings.severity: P2 (pre-existing; not attributable to this diff)
preexisting_findings.trigger: Prepare a graph successfully; retry preparing the same unchanged graph and scale; raise ENOSPC after truncating the first cell; then consult _prepared_spatial_cells.
preexisting_findings.observed: Both HEAD29ec7da and current return a cached prepared result referencing a one-byte graph-cell-00000.bin. A later explicit successful prepare restores all expected bytes.
preexisting_findings.reason: The old prepared.json survives while files are overwritten; cache validity checks only graph stamp and file existence.
preexisting_findings.possible_fix: Invalidate the manifest before rebuilding, or build in a generation directory and publish the completed generation atomically.
preexisting_findings.targeted_test: Prepare, fault-inject a write failure on the first cell during a same-source rebuild, then require _prepared_spatial_cells to return None (or the old complete generation), and verify a successful retry restores baseline bytes.
